title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Rebecca Harris is a Lecturer on Law for the Fashion Law Lab at Harvard Law School and has been part of the teaching team since the course’s inception. She has expertise in a range of areas within the fashion industry, including environmental and social sustainability, intellectual property, and NFTs and the Metaverse. Rebecca Harris is […]
